frontier: Erdos #979: smallest N that is a sum of three prime cubes in exactly 6 representations (OEIS A385316 a(6)).
action:
Milestone: verifier_construction; contract=sha256:8d51fc61fba0b1e156ad8e3f452b419d28072672bca2b1a6f006cf81817c23cc
Built a385316_verifier.py as a deterministic no-argument, no-network Python entrypoint that censuses all sums of three prime cubes up to cutoff C using complete prime set (all p with p³≤C), validates domain well-formedness (representable as p³+q³+r³) and the exact-n target predicate (exactly n unordered triples), replays domain and predicate kill fixtures with correct rejection branches, and reproduces known census terms a(1)=24 and a(2)=185527. Census to C=500,000 finds max multiplicity 2, consistent with prior census at 10¹² reporting max multiplicity 5. The gap to multiplicity 6 is wide.
